nodes.label: Grading the Unspoken: Evaluating Tacit Reasoning in Quantum Field Theory and String Theory with LLMs
nodes.author: Xingyang Yu, Yinghuan Zhang, Yufei Zhang, Zijun Cui

nodes.label: Tacit Knowledge in Theoretical Physics
nodes.rationale: Knowledge transmitted implicitly through research practice with intermediate steps routinely omitted in literature, requiring reconstruction by AI systems

nodes.label: Five-Level Grading Rubric
nodes.rationale: Decomposes correctness into statement correctness, key concept awareness, reasoning chain presence, tacit step reconstruction, and enrichment

nodes.label: Reasoning Geometry Framework
nodes.rationale: Two-dimensional space distinguishing mechanism-driven vs consistency-driven inference and single-structure vs cross-frame reasoning

nodes.label: Conceptual Hinge Tasks
nodes.rationale: Consistency-driven cross-frame reasoning requiring identification of latent structural distinction resolving conceptual tension before derivation

hyperedges.label: LLM Reasoning Evaluation Framework
hyperedges.rationale: Three papers collectively establish complementary evaluation methodologies: multi-level rubrics for tacit reasoning, error taxonomy for research tasks, and cost-aware metrics for efficiency
